thread:
maria: Heads up — need to export ~90 days of auth/audit logs to a partner SIEM for a compliance check. What's the minimum access pattern we should give them? @samir any thoughts?

samir: Prefer proxy exports via our SIEM-exporter service, not direct S3 access for external consumers. That keeps KMS decrypt in a single controlled path. :lock: 

maria: Good. We want to avoid long-lived keys or manual downloads. Is there a recommended ephemeral flow/runbook?

security-bot: Note: All SIEM export requests must be approved via /approvals and linked to an incident or compliance ticket. Approval ID will be posted to thread once initiated.

ashlee: We usually do presigned URLs scoped to a single prefix+timebox (24h), and route logs through redaction lambda before upload. Redaction owner for auth logs is @ryan.

ryan: Confirm. Redaction happens in the log-bridge pipeline. For partner exports we should: 1) apply field-level redaction rules, 2) sign export with ephemeral role, 3) encrypt with customer-specific KMS alias. That lambda needs kms:Decrypt for the export key but we can use a short-lived role to limit blast radius.

maria: Can you drop a minimal IAM condition snippet for the short-lived role? I want to propose it in the request template.

samir: Sure — example policy we use for exporter role: 

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalTag/export": "ephemeral"},
        "Bool": {"aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "true"}
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

samir: The key here is to bind the decrypt to a tagged temporary role and require MFA or session tag so only approved workflows can call it.

ashlee: Also a note on retention: partner requests 90 days but security wants to keep full fidelity internally for 365 days for investigations. We can export a redacted 90-day view and keep the raw logs behind internal RBAC.

ryan: Agreed. That means we need two privileges: "siem_exporter" (proxy + presigned + redaction) and "forensics_reader" (internal, longer retention). I'll open an infra PR to create the exporter role and an RFC for the retention policy differential.

maria: Please also include a wrinkle for emergency incident access — SOC oncall should be able to request a short-term unredacted snapshot via JIT with approval and audit trail.

ryan: Will add JIT flow to the PR. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4128 (WIP).

samir: I'll draft the approval template and add required fields: justification, retention window, export filter, redaction rules, approver, ticket link.

maria: Perfect. Action items: samir -> approval template; ryan -> infra PR + JIT flow; ashlee -> confirm redaction rules for auth logs; maria -> open partner request with proposed scope. I'll kick off /approvals now. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: Approval request APR-3892 created and sent to sec-compliance for review.
